segments.contextAfter: A Boolean. When set to [`YES`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ObjectiveC/YES), the system displays only your custom view controller in the notification interface. When set to [`NO`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ObjectiveC/NO), the system displays the default notification content in addition to your view controller’s content. Custom action buttons and the Dismiss button are always displayed, regardless of this setting. If you don’t specify this key, the default value is set to [`NO`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ObjectiveC/NO).
